decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Rotom is Ghost-type, so Fake Out (Normal) has no effect on it, and Flare Blitz (Fire) hits it neutrally since Ghost doesn't resist Fire. I need to consider which Rotom form this is, since the forme affects its secondary typing and resistances.

Weighing Incineroar's options against Rotom: Flare Blitz deals damage directly, while Parting Shot would debuff Rotom's offenses but bring in a teammate like Garchomp or Gholdengo instead. Garchomp's Ground typing makes it immune to Rotom's Electric attacks, while Gholdengo's Steel/Ghost typing doesn't resist Electric but is immune to Normal and Fighting — so the switch-in matters a lot for what Rotom can do next turn. Given Rotom's speed advantage, dealing immediate damage with Flare Blitz seems like the more practical line.

Since Rotom is faster anyway, it'll attack before any switch resolves regardless. I'll go with Parting Shot.
